🚨Philippines: Path to Destruction, Path to Hell, Path to an Ugly Future

How can some leaders so easily bow to neocon warmongers, offering our country up for destruction? Modern warfare isn’t like before, today’s weapons can erase an entire community in seconds.

 Look at Gaza: homes reduced to dust, children buried under rubble, entire neighborhoods wiped from existence.

Is this the path we want for the Philippines? Do you really want to march blind into that fire? War doesn’t just kill soldiers, it burns cities, poisons futures, and shatters generations. War is not glory. War is ugly. War is hell. And once it starts, there’s no turning back.

𝐓𝐑𝐀𝐅𝐅𝐈𝐂 𝐀𝐃𝐕𝐈𝐒𝐎𝐑𝐘

War-2 Movie pre release event is going to be held on 10.08.2025 from 5.00 PM to 10 PM at Yousufguda battallion, Police lines. Large number of public will attend the pre-release function. Moderate traffic congestion is expected with visitors and their vehicles on streets around KVBR Stadium. To avoid inconvenience, the commuters are advised to take following roads and avoid movement towards Kotla Vijaya Bhasker Stadium.

Traffic Diversions (for General Public) on 10.08.2025:
1. From Jubilee Hills Checkpost → Kotla Vijaya Bhasker Stadium → Divert at Krishna Nagar Junction → Srinagar Colony → Panjagutta.
 2. From Maitrivanam Junction → Jubilee Hills Checkpost/Madhapur → Divert at Yousufguda Basti → RBI Quarters → Krishna Nagar Junction → Jubilee Hills Checkpost.
 3. From Maitrivanam Junction → Borabanda Bus Stop → Divert at Savera Function Hall → Krishnakanth Park → GTS Temple → Kalyan Nagar → Mothi Nagar → Borabanda Bus Stop.
 4. From Borabanda Bus Stop → Maitrivanam Junction → Divert at Prime Garden, Kalyan Nagar → Midland Bakery → GTS Colony → Kalyan Nagar Junction → Umesh Chandra Statue U-Turn → ICICI U-Turn → Maitrivanam Junction.

Parking for Public:
Metro Parking (Janakamma Thota 1 & 2), Yousufguda
Savera Function Hall & Mahamood Function Hall – Four-wheelers only

Citizens are advised to follow the above traffic plan. For travel assistance, call Traffic Helpline 9010203626. For updates, follow @HyderabadTrafficPolice (FB) & @HYDTP (Twitter). Please cooperate with Hyderabad Traffic Police.
